pages.text: Control the spiritual energy inside your body to fly freely through the air.

$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Obtainment:$() Cannot be unlocked automatically through EP; it must be obtained by other means$(br)$(bold)Input:$() Press the skill key to toggle flight$(br)$(bold)Cost:$() 1.5 magicules per toggle, with no ongoing drain$(br2)When enabled on the ground with space overhead, it first lifts you 1 block and then enables high-speed flight. Press again to disable it. Each toggle has a 3-second cooldown.
